'''''Dhoro's Sorrow''''' was the personal [[Starship/Legends|starship]] of the criminal named
[[Grintlok]]. In [[2 ABY/Legends|2 ABY]] he and his accomplices used it to travel from the
[[Nelvana Gas Cluster/Legends|Nelvana Gas Cluster]] to [[Cataalda]].
